_about: The music -> gameplay mapping the composer reads. Every number here is a decision somebody can change after watching a cut; LEARNINGS.md says why each one is what it is. Features are normalised against the SONG (0..1), not the segment, so a quiet song's loudest bar still reads as its drop. Since cut 3 the music is answered by ORCHESTRATED GAMEPLAY (events), never by the camera. Since cut 6 (v3) every shot is a PHRASE: a setup over its bars and a payoff on the section boundary or the downbeat near its end, staged in one of twelve cells.

render._why: Nothing is real time: every sub-frame is drawn at 2x supersampling with 8x MSAA, and four 240 Hz sub-frames are averaged in linear light into each 60 fps output frame (a 180-degree shutter), so motion is smooth and blurred the way a camera sees it.
render._shutter: accum 2 of every 4 sub-frames = a 90-degree shutter: smooth, but a Sparrow round stays a glowing sphere instead of smearing into a white dash (Garrett, cut 3).
render._prefs_why: The game's own graphics settings for the shoot's profile (prefs.json): Ultra preset (presets 0-2 replace the HyperSea skybox with a baked panorama the engine cannot draw, cut cytoplasm to a quarter and cap the membrane), adaptive performance OFF (it had dropped the preset to Low at the software renderer's frame rate), Lush ecosystem, 8x MSAA, full VFX.
render._long: A cut longer than long_seconds renders at render_scale_long (1.5x supersampling): a 60 s cut is 3600 frames, and 1.5x on 8x MSAA is still cleaner than Unity's TAA at 1x. The 2x is for the 15 s milestones.

shots._why: Garrett (cut 5): 'longer shots where you could build up a narrative and some payoff'. Shots follow the song's sections: a section shorter than min_seconds merges into its shorter neighbour, one longer than max_seconds splits on downbeats, and a shot that ends where a drop begins runs payoff_tail_bars into the drop so the payoff lands ON the drop. A shot's payoff is the section boundary inside it, else the downbeat nearest payoff_position through it.

camera._why: Sickness-safe grammar (Garrett, cut 5: 'less erratic camera movements that are gonna make people sick'): every camera is a steady MOUNT riding behind, above and beside the pilot, heading smoothed over ~1.6 s, the horizon leaning only a quarter of the way with the hull; or an ORBIT no faster than 4 deg/s. No dollies, no pulses, no shakes, no cuts inside a shot. The field of view stays in 56-66. Back 40 / up 13 / side 12 keeps the pilot's hull readable at 1080p (at back 50 it was a speck in the smoke test); the loop mount sits behind and above (no side) so the circle reads as a circle.

_diversity: An archetype used earlier in the cut costs diversity_penalty, a cell already seen costs same_cell_penalty (Garrett, cut 5: 'scenes 5 times as diverse'); an archetype whose `sections` names the shot's section earns section_bonus.

events._about: Orchestration templates. `on`: start (the shot's first frame), half, bar (every downbeat), beat, strong (beats in the top half of beat strength), onset (hard onsets, top quartile); the PHRASE kinds: setup_bar / setup_beat / setup_strong (before the payoff), payoff, payoff-N / payoff+N (N seconds around it), release_bar / release_beat / release_strong (after it). `min_energy` gates a template by the shot's energy. `action all EVENT FRAMES` fires every AI hull at once (the payoff). {i} cycles 0-3, {j} 0-11 (the twelve nearest hulls), {b} Button 1-4, {b3} Button 1-3, {dir} the four herd directions, {dom} the four domains, {loop_s} the seconds from the shot's start to its payoff (one loop of `circle` closes on the payoff).

archetypes.name: arboretum-kit-combo
archetypes.what: The Arboretum: Borromean, coral-bloom and arbor flora, sharks and a brittlestar shoal, tadpoles, a fleet of fourteen hulls on the pilot's wake. THE KIT COMBO: the pilot fires ability 1, 2 and 3 on the setup bars, one per bar, and on the payoff fires ability 4 with a boost while the prisms around it burst. A verse, a build.

phrase.payoff: ability 4 + boost + a burst of prisms on the payoff

archetypes.name: lattice-rally
archetypes.what: The Lattice: quasicrystal, nested-gyroid and gyroid flora in four elements, quadfish and tadpole shoals, ALL twenty-one hull classes released around the pilot. Setup: the pilot's domain shifts every bar (the mass effect in four colours) and hulls boost on the strong beats. Payoff: every hull fires its fourth ability and the fleet's prisms burst. Bright, fast: a drop.

phrase.setup: the domain shifts every bar; hulls boost on the strong beats
phrase.payoff: every hull's ability 4 and a fleet-wide burst

archetypes.name: kaiju-siege
archetypes.what: The Garland with a Worm Colony kaiju: sixteen hulls, sharks, a brittlestar shoal and a pack hunter. The camera orbits the worm's head slowly. Setup: the fleet converges on the head bar by bar, abilities cycling. Payoff: every hull boosts in at once and the prisms around the fleet burst. Prisms burst around the pilot and the fleet, never at the worm (its body IS prisms). The heaviest drop.

phrase.setup: the fleet converges on the kaiju bar by bar
phrase.payoff: every hull boosts in at once; the fleet's prisms burst

archetypes.name: hesperides-loop
archetypes.what: The Hesperides: lantern, coral and frond flora, a brittlestar shoal and clawfish, eight hulls following the pilot. THE LOOP: the pilot flies one full circle through its own wake, the loop closing exactly on the payoff, when it fires ability 4 and the prisms it laid burst behind it. A verse, a breakdown.

phrase.setup: the pilot lays one loop, closing on the payoff
phrase.payoff: the loop closes: ability 4, a boost, the wake bursts

archetypes.name: wormhole-run
archetypes.what: The Crystal Wormhole: spires and reeds, two swarms and a quadfish shoal, twelve hulls in all four domains running with the pilot. Setup: the fleet boosts on the strong beats, the swarm rides the pilot's wake. Payoff: the pilot and the fleet fire ability 4 together, a fleet-wide burst. A build.

phrase.setup: the fleet boosts on the strong beats, the swarm on the wake
phrase.payoff: ability 4 from the pilot and every hull, a fleet-wide burst

archetypes.name: yggdra-shoal
archetypes.what: The Yggdra: pines, arbors and rosettes, two shoals, forty tadpoles and a leviathan, six hulls drifting with the pilot in a slow orbit. Setup: the shoal gathers on the pilot's wake bar by bar. Payoff: the shoal scatters upward as every hull fires ability 2. An intro, a breakdown.

phrase.setup: the shoal gathers on the pilot's wake
phrase.payoff: the shoal scatters upward; every hull fires ability 2

archetypes.name: swarm-siege
archetypes.what: The Swarm cell: swarm fields and grids, locusts and mobbers, wall and nerve flora, eighteen hulls. Setup: the fleet closes on the pilot while the swarm thickens around it and prisms burst on the bars. Payoff: the pilot boosts through, every hull fires ability 3 and the fleet's prisms burst. A noisy, textural drop.

phrase.setup: the fleet closes on the pilot, the swarm thickens, bursts on the bars
phrase.payoff: the pilot boosts through; every hull's ability 3; a fleet-wide burst

archetypes.name: tandava-joust
archetypes.what: The Tandava: SchwarzP, mandelbulb and cacti flora, sharks, piranhas and harriers, sixteen hulls. THE JOUST: setup, the pilot and the fleet are aimed head-on and close bar by bar, abilities cycling; payoff, they meet - boosts all round, bursts around the pilot and the fleet. A verse, a drop.

phrase.setup: the pilot and the fleet close head-on bar by bar
phrase.payoff: they meet: boosts all round, bursts around both

archetypes.name: geode-bloom
archetypes.what: The Geode: coral blooms, lanterns, apollonia and watershed flora, a brittlestar shoal, ten hulls. THE BLOOM: a new flora is planted on every setup bar (the cell grows under the pilot), and on the payoff a shoal of twenty brittlestars is released at once as the pilot fires ability 4. A build.

phrase.setup: a new flora planted on every bar
phrase.payoff: twenty brittlestars released at once; ability 4 and a burst

archetypes.name: orrery-drift
archetypes.what: The Orrery: rosettes, tendrils and fronds, a shoal, tadpoles and clawfish, eight hulls in a slow orbit around the pilot. Setup: the life gathers on the wake. Payoff: every hull fires ability 1 together and the shoal scatters. An outro, a breakdown.

phrase.setup: the life gathers on the pilot's wake
phrase.payoff: every hull's ability 1 together; the shoal scatters

archetypes.name: boneyard-stampede
archetypes.what: The Boneyard: spires and walls, two stampedes, two pack hunters, sharks and a brittlestar shoal, fourteen Ruby hulls. Setup: the fleet boosts in on every beat, the stampede on the pilot's heels. Payoff: a fleet-wide burst as every hull fires ability 4. A bass-heavy drop.

phrase.setup: the fleet boosts in on every beat, the stampede on the pilot's heels
phrase.payoff: a fleet-wide burst; every hull's ability 4

archetypes.name: zephyr-rally
archetypes.what: The Zephyr: reeds and fronds, a quadfish shoal and harriers, all twenty-one hulls in all four domains. Setup: the pilot's domain shifts every bar, the fleet cycles its abilities. Payoff: the pilot's ability 4 and a boost, every hull's ability 2. Bright, airy: a verse.

phrase.setup: the domain shifts every bar; the fleet cycles its abilities
phrase.payoff: the pilot's ability 4 and boost; every hull's ability 2

_population: Garrett (cut 5): '10 times as populated'. Every scene releases 60-100 fauna (shoals of 20-50, 6-8 sharks, a kaiju or a leviathan where it fits), 6-12 flora of 2-4 species, and 6-21 hulls - all twenty-one classes in the rallies. The settle (8 s) is the pilot's flight into the life.
_luminance_note: Measured mean luminance of the first cut's shots (0..1): Skim Race I2 0.03, Joust I3 0.11, Wildlife cage I3 0.19. The brightness targets follow that order so a bright bar lands in a bright arena.
_stage_note: Every archetype is STAGED in Menu_Main's lava-lamp cell (stage: menu): the cell selector's cells (any CellConfigDataSO by name), the Toy Box's spawn pipelines (the roster's 21 vessel classes as AI pilots, every catalogue species of fauna and flora) and the director's events compose each scene like an orchestra. The arcade-mode archetypes of cuts 1-4 and the four scenes of cut 5 are kept in milestones/ for the record.
